gizmo.title: Iqembu Lamanothi Okuma
gizmo.description: Hlanganisa amanothi okuma amaningana ebhlokhini elilodwa elibonisa inothi elilodwa ngesikhathi, njengo-Amathiphu noma Okusha. Amakhadi emiyalelo, amanothi aseceleni nezicaphuno ezisohlakeni kungahlanganiswa nawo.

configure.title: Ilebula
configure.description: Igama leqembu elimenyezelwa abafundi besikrini, njengo-Amathiphu noma Okusha.

configure.title: Amanothi
configure.description: Amanothi okuma aseqenjini. Amakhadi emiyalelo, amanothi aseceleni nezicaphuno ezisohlakeni nakho kungengezwa.
